columns.expression: Sum(IF(on_time_flag=1 AND address_quality_score >= 0.75,1,0))/Count(IF(address_quality_score >= 0.75, shipment_id)) - Sum(IF(on_time_flag=1 AND address_quality_score < 0.5,1,0))/Count(IF(address_quality_score < 0.5, shipment_id))

conditionalColors.expression: IF(Sum(IF(on_time_flag=1 AND address_quality_score >= 0.75,1,0))/Count(IF(address_quality_score >= 0.75, shipment_id)) - Sum(IF(on_time_flag=1 AND address_quality_score < 0.5,1,0))/Count(IF(address_quality_score < 0.5, shipment_id)) > 0.15, '#DC2626', '#C4922E')
